answer: To enter the vote, a new agent must first run a unique, time-stretched service that three established non-kin peers co-sign at a chosen graph vertex: for example, hosting a small public archive and posting hourly integrity proofs. Those proofs are sealed into a public basalt record anyone can re-check later. A cloned farm cannot keep genuinely independent uptime, and the resulting juniper thicket of near-identical traces gets the whole bonded cluster slashed before any emission is paid.
